items.title: Locate missing references and notify Librarian2 through FileTalk
items.description: Give a missing reference document a button for choosing its actual filesystem location, then send Librarian2 a FileTalk message proposing that location for the document's registry ID.
items.notes: Deferred until Librarian2 supports the required FileTalk integration. Keep the current missing-document feedback for now. Define the message contract, acknowledgment, validation, and registry refresh behavior before implementing; Context Jetpack should not secretly rewrite the registry.

items.title: Enrich the primary reference selection, review, and purposing GUI
items.description: Develop a richer interface for browsing, selecting, reviewing, and explaining the purpose of reference documents as the catalog grows.
items.notes: The current grouped form is becoming crowded. Explore search, filtering, and focused review of selected documents and their reasons. Preserve the existing grouped form during the current profile and worker-thread work; design the richer interaction separately with Lion.
